title: hypolepis rugosula subsp. villosoviscida

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and mechanisms of this plant's bioactive constituents on human health.
